facts.text: The hotel is located on Belle Isle, steps away from South Beach.

facts.text: The Standard Spa, Miami Beach describes itself as less a hotel and more an adults-only spa with guest rooms.

facts.text: Rooms feature private terraces, many with outdoor soaking tubs.

facts.text: An indoor and outdoor hydrotherapy playground is complimentary to hotel guests.

facts.text: Spa facilities include hydrotherapy, a Turkish-style hammam, an aroma steam room, a sauna, an ice room, a Roman waterfall hot tub, an arctic plunge, treatment baths and an infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: You can select from hydrotherapy, Turkish-style hammam, aroma steam room, sauna, ice room, Roman waterfall hot tub, arctic plunge, treatment baths, and an infinity pool.

facts.text: The spa encourages the communal rituals of ancient bathing traditions.
facts.excerpt: The Spa encourages the communal rituals of ancient bathing traditions

facts.text: The hotel runs a daily schedule of wellness and fitness classes and a workshop series with in-house staff and international teachers.

facts.text: The hotel hosts retreats, lectures, classes, seminars and events led by local, national and international figures in health, fitness, spirituality, art and more.
facts.excerpt: With our comprehensive series of retreats, lectures, classes, seminars and events led by local, national and international luminaries in health, fitness, spirituality, sexuality, art, science, business and more

facts.text: Lido Bayside serves global-inspired dining on the bay.

facts.text: Guests may use the pool, spa and gym before check-in and after check-out.
facts.excerpt: You are welcome to arrive as early or stay as late as you'd like during your stay.

facts.text: Non-guests can buy Monday to Thursday day passes giving access to the pool and third-floor spa amenities.
